stemMarkdown: A is 3 times as efficient as B. Working together, they complete a job in 4 days. In how many days can A alone complete the job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Let B's rate be $r$ per day; A's rate is $3r$. Combined rate $= (3+1)r = 1/4$, so $r = \dfrac{1}{4\times4}$. A's rate $= 3r$, so A alone takes $\dfrac{1}{3r} = \dfrac{4\times4}{3} = 5.33$ days.
